name: grove-platform-java
description: Java (JUnit / Maven) support for Grove documentation testing

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Grove Java test commands are disabled in untrusted workspaces because mvn test executes project build targets.

grove.java.utilitiesTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the Maven utilities install (comparison-library) before tests run.

grove.java.testTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the Maven test phase.

grove.java.mavenPath.description: Path to the mvn executable. Uses mvn on PATH when empty.

grove.java.skipUtilitiesBuild.description: Skip mvn install for utilities/comparison-library before running tests. Enable only when dependencies are already installed locally.

commands.title: Grove: Run Current Java Test File
